title: High-throughput mass spectrometry analysis of N-glycans and protein markers after FUT8 knockdown in the syngeneic SW480/SW620 colorectal cancer cell model
projectDescription: MS analysis of proteins from FUT8-knockdown SW480 and SW620 colorectal cancer cells
sampleProcessingProtocol: DMEM High-Glucose provided was chosen as the culture medium to keep cell growth conditions. R6K6 (light, L) and R10K8 (heavy, H) alternatives were used for SILAC. A cell suspension was processed by ultracentrifugation to obtain three protein fractions (F1, F2, and F3). 100 μg of protein from these cell lysates from the protein fraction F3 were reconstituted in 20 μL of pH 7.4 buffer (0.2M Tris-HCl, 2% w/v SDS and 20% v/v glycerol) and mixed with 4 μL of SDS-PAGE loading buffer for performing an in-gel trypsin digestion. The protein samples were incubated for 12 h at 37 °C with 30 μL of trypsin, and then 50 μL of 5% (v/v) formic acid (FA) was added for stopping the reaction. The supernatant was transferred to a fresh LoBind tube and the peptides were isolated using 3 consecutive 50% (v/v) ACN/0.1% (v/v) trifluoroacetic acid (TFA) extractions and a final wash with ACN. The samples were dried and stored at -20 °C until use. The peptide extracts were analysed by MS at the Proteomics Unit of the Cancer Research Centre of the University of Salamanca (CiC-USAL, Spain; centre associated with the ProteoRed network, PRB2-ISCIII). MS spectra were obtained using an ESI-LTQ Orbitrap velos ETD mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher) coupled to an acquity nanoHPLC (Waters) equipped with a Symmetry C18 precolumn (5 μm, 20 mm x 180 μm), and a BEH C18 column (1.7 μm, 75ID 25 cm), which was eluted with a 1-40% ACN/ 0.1 FA gradient (120 min). Sample aliquots of 5 μL (0.15 μg/μL) were injected and HCD (Higher-energy Collision Dissociation) and ETD (Electron Transfer Dissociation) fragmentation patterns were obtained to ensure the highest quality results.
dataProcessingProtocol: The spectra data were processed using MaxQuant v1.5.6.5, Perseus v1.5.6.0 and the UniProt database. The isotopic incorporation rate was calculated using the formula of mean incorporation (%) = 1 - (1/(mean+1)) x 100 34. Furthermore, as the medium was not supplemented with proline, the data is expected to show an interconversion of arginine to proline. The interconversion was determined by MaxQuant to be 7.7%, and this value was used to correct the proteome quantification data. Analyses of the interactional networks of functional proteins were performed using STRING (Protein-Protein Interaction Networks Functional Enrichment Analysis) v.10.0 (http://string-db.org) and PANTHER (Protein Analysis Trough Evolutionary Relationships) v.17.0 (http://www.pantherdb.org) databases
keywords: Core fucosylation; colorectal cancer; glycomics; proteomics; mass spectrometry; profiling
